Match a warm cartoon storybook style with thick clean dark-brown outlines, a narrow cream cut-paper outer rim, big simple expressive brown eyes, compact sturdy quadruped horse proportions, grouped mane shapes, flat warm colors and angular two-tone cel shading. No realistic fur, hatching or painterly texture. Three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. Calm alert standing pose, neck and head upright, friendly curious eye, one ear forward and the other slightly sideways. Full horse, four complete hooves planted on the same baseline, body level. Tail hangs freely on the LEFT with a readable gap from the back legs; slightly curved dark mane with a soft forelock. The pale golden cream coat makes it distinct from a chestnut companion. No saddle, bridle, clothes, horn or other accessories. Frame the entire horse with visible transparent padding around all ears, tail and hooves; approximately square composition. No environment, floor, shadow, grass, lettering, other characters or floating artifacts. Clean genuine alpha transparency outside the illustrated paper rim. This will be animated using subtle mesh movement for breathing, ears, head and tail; keep all shapes broad and readable.

Create a polished character concept sheet for the cozy fantasy paper-cutout RPG Arkmon. Title in elegant modest serif type: 'Wache von Aurenfeld'. One very large full-body illustration occupies the left two-thirds of the sheet, three smaller head-and-shoulders portraits stacked vertically at the right labelled 'Neutral', 'Freundlich', 'Aufmerksam'. All depict EXACTLY the same new adult castle guard with identical face, hair and outfit. The character must match a warm hand-drawn cartoon RPG cast: thick clean dark-brown contour lines, narrow warm cream cut-paper border, large expressive simple oval brown eyes, large head and compact body approximately 3.5 heads tall, angular clean two-tone shading, restrained subtle paper texture. Not realistic, not 3D, not anime rendering, not intricate gritty painterly medieval art. The cast includes a large-eyed brown-haired young prince with cream shirt, brown vest, tan trousers and brown boots, and a kindly stocky bearded man with olive hat and vest; design this guard to belong beside them but have his own silhouette and face. Guard about 35, short neatly swept dark brown hair, a small friendly moustache WITHOUT a beard, slightly long rounded nose, warm medium skin, reassuring approachable expression, sturdy but not bulky. No hat or helmet so the face reads clearly. Forest-green short sleeveless tabard over cream padded sleeves and compact matte blue-grey light metal shoulder guards and small forearm guards, tan trousers, sturdy leather brown boots, plain leather belt with a small brass buckle, a sheathed short sword hanging clearly from his left hip. An understated small ivory eight-point star on the chest, four long cardinal points and four shorter diagonal points, matching the Aurenfeld heraldic star. Do not add large coat of arms, no cloak or cape, no lamp or summoning gem, no staff or spear, no huge armour. Full-body idle pose three-quarter view facing slightly toward image right, relaxed weight, both feet on the same ground line, hands relaxed and anatomically connected, friendly watchful bearing. Portrait 1 calmly neutral, portrait 2 warm smile with relaxed brows, portrait 3 alert attentive with slightly raised brows and closed mouth, not angry. Keep identical proportions and readable clean graphic shapes. Background warm pale parchment with generous blank space, only a very faint grounding shadow beneath full figure; no castle environment, no UI frame, no diagrams, no extra accessories, no colour swatches. High resolution clean concept art presentation.

Extract and refine ONLY the full-body guard from the approved attached Arkmon concept sheet into a clean single game sprite, genuinely transparent alpha background. Preserve exact identity, swept short brown hair, neat moustache, warm skin, large brown eyes, green tabard with ivory eight-point star, cream padded sleeves, small grey shoulder and forearm armour, tan trousers, brown boots, sheathed sword on his left hip. Same dark brown clean cartoon outlines, warm narrow ivory paper-cut border, angular two-tone shading. Whole body in relaxed standing idle pose three-quarter facing RIGHT, both arms naturally relaxed, closed small friendly smile. Make compact friendly RPG proportions approx 3.6 heads tall by slightly shortening legs compared to concept, not a realistic tall adult. Keep head, face and clothing faithful to concept. No title, portraits, lettering, paper backdrop, vignette, floor shadow, particles or other characters. One centered isolated full-body figure with generous transparent margin, everything inside image.

Transform the supplied guard sprite into a production walk-cycle spritesheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, exactly EIGHT complete full-body frames, no labels or grid. Every cell equal sized with generous transparent padding and same ground baseline and hip center. Preserve EXACTLY this guard's identity, face, moustache, short brown swept hair, green star tabard, cream sleeves, grey shoulder and arm armour, belt, tan trousers, boots and sheathed sword. Same illustrated paper cartoon dark-brown outlines and narrow cream cutout border. Keep identical head/body proportions, scale and three-quarter RIGHT-facing angle in all eight frames. A calm purposeful continuous walking cycle, not running, eyes open, face steady, sword remains sheathed and attached to belt. Row-major frames: 1 near leg forward/far leg back contact; 2 weight settles/near knee bends; 3 far foot passes under hip/near foot pushes back; 4 far leg swings forward/near leg back; 5 far leg forward/near leg back contact; 6 far knee settles; 7 near foot passes under hip/far foot pushes back; 8 near leg swings forward/far leg back. Arms swing opposite the legs with natural small bends. Clearly alternate BOTH legs rather than repeat same step. Smooth modest body bob, no big head movement. Entire character and boots completely contained in each cell. Truly transparent alpha background, no shadows or backdrop, no extra objects, no motion lines, no text.
assets.refinementPrompt: Clean the background of this exact 4-column 2-row guard walk-cycle sprite sheet. Keep every guard drawing, all eight poses, their exact cell positions and scale, facial design, clothing, hands and boots unchanged. REMOVE ALL white/grey paper backdrop, cloudy haze, grey cast shadows, grain and faint semitransparent pixels in the empty areas. The entire area outside the narrow cream contour of each character must be 100 percent transparent, alpha zero. Preserve the thin cream cutout rim directly attached to each character; no glow or drop shadow beyond it. This is a game sprite atlas, so any milky translucent rectangle in the empty area is unacceptable. Clean transparent background only; no words, no new poses, no new objects.

Top LEFT neutral calm closed mouth; top RIGHT warmly friendly smiling; bottom LEFT surprised alert with raised brows and small open mouth; bottom RIGHT mildly concerned attentive, raised inner eyebrows, gently closed mouth, not angry. Entire hair and both shoulders contained within each cell with generous transparent margins. Consistent scale and position in each cell, no hands, weapons, words, titles, cell borders, backdrop or drop shadows. Real alpha transparency.

Convert this exact approved moustached Aurenfeld guard into a production paper-puppet CUTOUT PARTS ATLAS for skeletal animation, 3 columns by 2 rows, exactly SIX separate pieces, one piece per cell. Preserve exact cartoon style, brown outlines, cream narrow edge, warm skin, swept brown hair and moustache, green tabard with ivory eight-point star, cream sleeves, grey light armour, brown belt, tan trousers and brown boots. All pieces three-quarter RIGHT facing as original, same design. Layout strict: TOP LEFT head and torso ONLY: full original hair/face/neck/chest, green tabard, brown belt, tabard skirt; NO arms, NO hands, NO legs, NO sword. The shoulder socket surfaces must be complete green cloth beneath where arms will overlap. TOP MIDDLE complete near arm, from rounded grey shoulder pauldron through cream upper sleeve, elbow, grey bracer and relaxed hand; straight relaxed downward pose, slight natural elbow bend. TOP RIGHT complete far arm from shoulder to hand, same downward pose, slightly narrower. BOTTOM LEFT complete NEAR LEG ONLY: rounded upper thigh attachment, tan trouser thigh and shin, brown boot with toe pointing RIGHT, leg hangs near vertically with only slight relaxed knee bend. BOTTOM MIDDLE complete FAR LEG ONLY, matching length and boot design, relaxed near vertical, toe RIGHT. BOTTOM RIGHT the complete SHEATHED SWORD including brass hilt and brown leather scabbard, vertical. Absolutely no duplicate whole characters, no extra limbs. Complete rounded overlap padding at shoulders and upper thighs so joints can rotate without gaps. Each part centred in its own equal cell with transparent empty separation and generous margins; individual piece may fill most of its cell independent of the other pieces' scale. No labels, grid lines, annotations, backdrop, floor, shadows, glow, haze. Pure zero-alpha background outside the narrow cream contour around each piece. Keep character identity and outfit unchanged.
